title: QA to Documentation Handoff Artifact
description: Structured artifact produced by the QA Orchestrator and consumed by the Documentation Orchestrator. Contains the verified codebase reference, full test results, known limitations, security sign-off, and performance summary.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema used to produce the artifact.

projectName.description: Human-readable name of the target project as configured in This Project.

verifiedCodebaseReference.description: Reference to the exact codebase revision verified by QA.

commitHash.description: Full Git commit hash of the verified codebase state.

branch.description: Git branch on which verification was performed.

verifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when QA verification was completed.

testResults.description: Summary of all test outcomes across the QA phase.

unitTestsPassed.description: True if all unit tests pass with no failures or errors.

integrationTestsPassed.description: True if all integration tests pass with no failures or errors.

e2eTestsPassed.description: True if all end-to-end tests pass with no failures or errors.

totalDefectsFound.description: Total number of defects raised during the QA phase.

totalDefectsResolved.description: Total number of defects resolved and re-verified. Must equal totalDefectsFound for gate to pass.

knownLimitationsLog.description: Documented limitations and edge cases discovered during QA that are accepted and will be noted in documentation. Empty if none.

impact.description: Who is affected by this limitation and under what conditions.

workaround.description: Known workaround, or 'none' if no workaround exists.

securitySignOff.description: Security reviewer sign-off confirming the codebase has been assessed against the OWASP Top 10.

reviewedBy.description: Name of the agent that performed the security review (always 'security-reviewer').

owaspFindingsStatus.description: Summary status of the OWASP Top 10 assessment.

openFindings.description: Any OWASP findings that remain open. Empty if all mitigated.

signOffGranted.description: True only when no critical or high OWASP findings remain open.

performanceSummary.description: Performance characteristics observed during QA testing.

metric.description: Name of the metric (e.g., 'p99 response time').

bottlenecksIdentified.description: Performance bottlenecks identified and their impact. Empty if none.

meetsNonFunctionalRequirements.description: True if all performance non-functional requirements from the discovery artifact are satisfied.

ticketKey.description: Optional validated TICKET_KEY scoping this run to knowledge-base/plans/active/<TICKET_KEY>/. Must match the pattern ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[1-9][0-9]*$. Absent for offline runs.

sessionPath.description: Optional active artifact directory derived from ticketKey. Defaults to knowledge-base/plans/active/ when absent.
